# Wranngle Systems

> Wranngle Systems LLC builds AI voice agents, workflow automation, lead capture, and proposal-generation systems for teams with real customer follow-up. Founder: Cody Arnold, Lead Automation Engineer with 10+ years across 500+ SMB client environments; an inbound on-call voice agent he built on the ElevenLabs Agents platform runs in production across 5 client organizations spanning 20+ sites.
